purpose: Define ordering, limiting and pagination semantics explicitly so result subsets are deterministic where required and never acquire semantic priority accidentally.

owns: DWH Order, Limit and Pagination semantics

topics.name: DWH Order, Limit and Pagination
topics.purpose: Define ordering, limiting and pagination semantics explicitly so result subsets are deterministic where required and never acquire semantic priority accidentally.

semantics.stable_rule: When deterministic pagination is required, ordering includes a stable total or tie-breaking key/profile.
semantics.limit_rule: Limit is an explicit result-bound parameter and does not alter source semantics.
semantics.offset_rule: Offset/page/cursor semantics are explicit and profile-specific.
semantics.cursor_rule: Cursor tokens are transient query-state identities and never source record identities.
semantics.priority_rule: Result order is presentation/query semantics and does not imply domain priority unless an explicit priority field is queried.
semantics.change_rule: Pagination over changing source data may shift unless snapshot/cursor consistency is explicitly requested.
semantics.authority_rule: Pagination does not broaden authorized result scope.

invariants.rule: A DWH query is an explicit read/projection definition over exact resolved schema/instance/relation identities; querying, filtering, joining, aggregating, ordering or paginating never silently changes source ownership, identity or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: pagination without deterministic order claimed stable
display order treated as domain priority

references.purpose: Ordering/pagination belong to exact query semantics.

prose.summary: Define ordering, limiting and pagination semantics explicitly so result subsets are deterministic where required and never acquire semantic priority accidentally.
